load_bvh_motion: load a BVH motion file with Motion.LoadFromBVH and apply a scale factor
create_actor_entity: create an Actor entity in the scene using AI4Animation.Scene.AddEntity and AddComponent
get_bone_transformations: get bone transformations at a timestamp using Motion.GetBoneTransformations with bone names
set_actor_transforms: apply bone transformations to an Actor using SetTransforms and SyncToScene
draw_3d_text_label: draw a 3D text label above an actor bone using AI4Animation.Draw.Text3D
